LanguageData.BOR_DarkPact_AboutText:
Tenebral research is unlocked at the dark mirror's Pacts tab: pick a research, a colonist communes with the mirror, and the Dark Archotechs name one price that must be paid within {0}, or everyone the mirror's pulse reaches suffers Dark Punishment.

The possible prices:

 - Kill people: your colony must kill {1} humans.
 - Kill animals: your colony must land the killing blow on {2} animals; ones that bleed out later do not count.
 - Burn alive: {3} people must die while burning, by anyone's hand.
 - Harvest organs: your surgeons must cut {4} natural organs out of living people.
 - Ossuary: {5} human corpses must lie within {6} cells of a dark mirror at the same time.
 - Destroy a settlement: your colony must raze a named nearby settlement of a faction that is not hostile to you.
 - Execute a colonist: a named colonist must be executed by your colony.
 - Betray guests: your colony must kill {7} traders, visitors, lodgers or allied soldiers while they still trust you.
 - Kinslayer: a named colonist must personally kill a named relative or partner.

The last four only appear when they are possible.
